{a.1} "This religion that I have chosen is superior and (5) better than the other, earlier religions in ten things.

First, that the religions of the forerunners was in one land and one language. Then my religion (10) was *able to be revealed in every land and in all languages and be taught in distant lands.

{a.2} Second, that the previous religions <persisted> as long as long as there were pure leaders in them. And when the leaders were raised up (to Paradise), (15) then their religion was changed and they became slack in commandments and deeds. And they were deceived through [I/V] greed, fire, and [lust]. But my [religion] will stand firm and through living teachers, (5) bishops, elects, and hearers and through its wisdom and deeds it will endure until the very end.

{a.3} Third, that the previous souls, whose deeds were not fulfilled in (10) their own religion come to my religion and it will be itself the door to their release.

But dead flesh of any animals, wherever they obtain it, be it dead or (10) slaughtered, they may eat. And whenever they obtain it, either through trading or as a livelyhood or as a present, they may eat it. And that is enough for them. This is the first (15) precept for hearers.
